ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between dominant low-intensity (dark) and localized high-intensity (white/tan) pixel regions across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: One large irregular high-intensity tan/white blob on the inner-left lobe. Multiple high-intensity circular clusters (barnacle colonies) at the extreme distal tips. Several thin, linear high-intensity streaks scattered across the predominantly dark pixel field on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible central V-shaped notch with a sharp vertex; the angle is approximately 75 degrees relative to the lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary with variable pixel-level amplitudes, most pronounced at the outer terminal edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward curvature extending from the median notch to the outer fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular high-contrast white pixels concentrated at the terminal left and right tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple non-parallel high-intensity linear segments detected across both lobes, cutting across the natural dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular depigmented patch on the left lobe; heavy barnacle encrustations on the terminal ends of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical high-intensity pixel trails (falling water droplets) extending from the left fluke tip downwards.
